title: Fresh Ambiance
description: A vanilla-friendly Atmospherics preset resource pack that enhances Minecraft's environmental colors and atmosphere with carefully tuned visuals.
body: > **This resource pack requires [Atmospherics](https://modrinth.com/mod/atmospherics) to work.** > It is an Atmospherics preset and won't have any effect without the mod. > > > > --- # Overview ![plains](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/098d3bc66bc77913c94611e137fb2ff33058328d_0.webp) This resource pack is a preset for **Atmospherics** that adjusts fog and environmental colors to give each biome a more distinctive atmosphere while keeping the vanilla style. ## Features - 🌫️ Custom fog settings - 🌲 Biome-specific atmosphere - 🎨 Vanilla-friendly visuals - ⚡ Lightweight and compatible with most resource packs
